about: Human-reviewed corrections to the automated TASK-SUCCESS results on the held-out questions. These correct the MEASUREMENT (the marks), never PlantMind. Each correction is a person's decision under rules locked before the results were seen, and points to the review that records it. A future task-success card reads this file next to the automated result files and shows both numbers.

factual_correctness.unit: The judge scores CLAIMS (RAGAS splits our facts into claims); the person scores FACTS. present = facts in the answer with the same meaning and numbers. borderline = counted missing in 'present', present in the high figure. wrong = the answer gives a different value or procedure for the fact.

H1.note: F7: answer gives the seal-change sign-off (First-Bottle Check, shift supervisor) instead of the pre-start checklist signed by the shift lead

H3.why: RAGAS merged F1 into F2's claim and F4 into F3's claims when splitting; F1 checked by hand (present), F4 covered by claims 3-4 (present)

H5.note: F2: answer blames checkweigher calibration drift (in no document) instead of worn seals

lost_at.about: Where each missing fact was lost, using retrieval recall and the handover-recall manual review

goal_accuracy.v1_note: v1 (RAGAS, goal_accuracy.json) judge passed 6/23; the person's v1 review (reports/goal-accuracy/v1-review.md) gave 17/23 (18/23 with B) and is the v2 calibration answer key.

calibration.why: H2 G2: the judge's quote joined two bullet points without the '- '; every part is in the answer. The quote checker does not ignore bullet markers (a future rule change).

G2.why: quote genuine: 'Safety - lock out and tag out (LOTO)...' and 'Never reach into the infeed or the star wheel while the machine is running' are both in the answer, as separate bullet points

borderline.note: v2 judge passed it on the guard rule alone; the reach-in part is not in the answer. Counted as a pass in the headline (18/23), as a fail in the low figure (17/23).
